meta.name: give-me-tips
meta.description: Explains any senpi tip in depth, including Tip: lines in the TUI. Use when the user asks about a tip, what a tipped feature does, or which tips they can see.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 看懂工具里的每条提示,弄清它到底能做什么
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果看到工具里的提示却不知道它具体指什么。
copy.tagline_en: Understand what each in-tool tip actually does before you rely on it
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you spot a tip while using the tool and want to know what it really does.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会先列出当前版本实际存在的 tip 列表并读取对应代码，再按你提问的语言，用具体机制（触发事件、门槛、文件路径）解释那条 tip，而不是复述 tip 原文。
howto.when: 当你问起某条 tip 的含义、它提到的功能怎么工作，或你能看到哪些 tip 时触发。它会先读你的 settings 和 tip 历史，说明你本人能遇到哪些 tip。

say.text: 那条 Tip: 提示是什么意思？
say.note: 会解释该条 tip 的确切机制

say.text: 这个提示说的功能是怎么实现的？
say.note: 会先读代码再给出具体机制

say.text: 我这边能看到哪些 tip？
say.note: 会读你的设置说明哪些能遇到

howto.what_en: After install, Claude lists the tips that exist in your version, reads the code behind the one you ask about, and explains it in your language with concrete mechanics—events, gates, file paths.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask about a tip, what a tipped feature does, or which tips you can see. It reads your settings and tip history to say which tips you can meet.

say_en.text: What does that Tip: line mean?
How does the feature that tip mentions work?
say_en.note: Reads the code, then gives concrete mechanics.
Reads your settings to say which you'll meet.
